milestones.title: MiniLang Tokenizer & Lexical Analyzer
milestones.objective:
Create `minilang/__init__.py`, `minilang/lexer.py`, and `tests/test_m1_lexer.py` (keep total milestone diff compact, under 350 lines).

Requirements for `minilang/lexer.py`:
1. `TokenType(Enum)` with members: `INT`, `FLOAT`, `STRING`, `IDENT`, `LET`, `FN`, `IF`, `ELSE`, `RETURN`, `PLUS`, `MINUS`, `STAR`, `SLASH`, `EQ` (`==`), `NEQ` (`!=`), `LT` (`<`), `GT` (`>`), `LE` (`<=`), `GE` (`>=`), `ASSIGN` (`=`), `LPAREN` (`(`), `RPAREN` (`)`), `LBRACE` (`{`), `RBRACE` (`}`), `COMMA` (`,`), `SEMI` (`;`), `EOF`.
2. `@dataclass class Token`: fields `type: TokenType`, `value: Any`, `line: int = 1`, `col: int = 1`.
3. `class LexError(Exception)`: stores `message: str`, `line: int = 1`, `col: int = 1` and includes `line` and `col` in its string message.
4. `tokenize(src: str) -> List[Token]`:
   - Tokenizes integer literals (`TokenType.INT`, `int` value) and float literals (`TokenType.FLOAT`, `float` value).
   - Tokenizes double- or single-quoted string literals (`TokenType.STRING`, unescaped `str` value); raises `LexError` with line/col on unterminated strings.
   - Tokenizes identifiers (`TokenType.IDENT`) and keywords (`let`->`LET`, `fn`->`FN`, `if`->`IF`, `else`->`ELSE`, `return`->`RETURN`).
   - Tokenizes arithmetic (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`), comparison (`==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`), assignment (`=`), and punctuation (`(`, `)`, `{`, `}`, `,`, `;`).
   - Skips `#` comments until end of line and tracks 1-based `line` and `col` for every token.
   - Appends a trailing `Token(TokenType.EOF, None, line, col)` and raises `LexError` on unknown characters.
5. Export `Token`, `TokenType`, `LexError`, `tokenize` from `minilang/__init__.py`.
6. Write unit tests in `tests/test_m1_lexer.py` covering integers, floats, strings, keywords, identifiers, operators, `#` comments, line/col positions, and `LexError` cases.

milestones.title: MiniLang AST Nodes & Recursive-Descent Parser
milestones.objective:
Create `minilang/ast_nodes.py`, `minilang/parser.py`, and `tests/test_m2_parser.py` (and optionally export in `minilang/__init__.py`), building on `minilang/lexer.py` from `m1_lexer`. Keep the milestone delta compact (under 400 lines).

Requirements for `minilang/ast_nodes.py`:
Define clean `@dataclass` AST nodes:
- `NumberLiteral(value: Union[int, float])`, `StringLiteral(value: str)` (and alias `Literal = NumberLiteral`)
- `Identifier(name: str)`
- `UnaryOp(op: str, operand: Any)` (where `op` is `'-'` or `'+'`)
- `BinaryOp(op: str, left: Any, right: Any)` (where `op` is `'+'`, `'-'`, `'*'`, `'/'`, `'=='`, `'!='`, `'<'`, `'>'`, `'<='`, `'>='`)
- `LetStmt(name: str, expr: Any)`
- `ReturnStmt(expr: Any)`
- `Block(statements: List[Any])`
- `IfExpr(cond: Any, then_branch: Any, else_branch: Optional[Any] = None)`
- `FnDef(name: str, params: List[str], body: Any)`
- `CallExpr(callee: str, args: List[Any])`
- `Program(statements: List[Any])`

Requirements for `minilang/parser.py`:
- `class ParseError(Exception)`
- `parse(src: str) -> Program`: recursive-descent parser using `tokenize(src)` from `minilang.lexer`:
  - Operator precedence (highest to lowest):
    1. Primary: `INT`/`FLOAT` -> `NumberLiteral`, `STRING` -> `StringLiteral`, `IDENT` -> `Identifier` or `CallExpr(name, args)` when followed by `(`, parenthesized `(expr)`, and `if` expressions.
    2. Unary: `-x`, `+x` -> `UnaryOp`.
    3. Multiplicative: `*`, `/` (left-associative `BinaryOp`).
    4. Additive: `+`, `-` (left-associative `BinaryOp`).
    5. Comparison: `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` (left-associative `BinaryOp`).
  - Statements & expressions (optional `;` between statements):
    - `let <ident> = <expr>` -> `LetStmt`
    - `fn <ident>(<p1>, <p2>, ...) { <stmts> }` (and `let <ident> = fn(<p1>, ...) { <stmts> }`) -> `FnDef`
    - `return <expr>` -> `ReturnStmt`
    - `if <cond> { <stmts> } else { <stmts> }` (supporting optional parentheses around `<cond>`, optional `else` or `else if`, and either `{ ... }` blocks or single expressions) -> `IfExpr`
    - Expression statements.
- Write unit tests in `tests/test_m2_parser.py` verifying precedence (`* /` over `+ -` over comparisons), unary `-`, parentheses, `let`, `if/else`, `fn` & calls, and `ParseError`.

milestones.title: MiniLang Lexical Environment, Closures & Tree-Walking Evaluator
milestones.objective:
Create `minilang/evaluator.py` and `tests/test_m3_evaluator.py` (and export in `minilang/__init__.py` if helpful), building on `minilang/ast_nodes.py` and `minilang/parser.py` from `m2_parser`. Keep the milestone delta compact (under 400 lines).

Requirements for `minilang/evaluator.py`:
1. `class EvalError(Exception)`: raised on division-by-zero (`/` by `0` or `0.0`), undefined variable lookup, undefined function call, or arity mismatch.
2. `class Environment`:
   - `__init__(self, parent: Optional[Environment] = None, values: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)`
   - `define(self, name: str, value: Any) -> Any` (or `set`): binds `name` in the current scope.
   - `get(self, name: str) -> Any`: resolves `name` in current or ancestor `parent` scopes, raising `EvalError` if undefined.
3. `evaluate(src_or_node: Union[str, Any], env: Optional[Environment] = None) -> Any`:
   - If given a `str`, parses it via `parse(src_or_node)`.
   - Evaluates `Program` / `Block` statements sequentially, returning the last expression value or early `return` value.
   - Evaluates `NumberLiteral`, `StringLiteral`, `Identifier`, `UnaryOp`, `BinaryOp` (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`; raises `EvalError` on division by 0).
   - Evaluates `LetStmt`, `IfExpr` (truthy condition executes `then_branch`, falsy executes `else_branch` or returns `None`/`0`), `FnDef` (captures defining `Environment` as a lexical closure), `CallExpr` (creates child `Environment(parent=closure_env)`, binds parameters, supports recursion and closures), and `ReturnStmt`.
4. Write unit tests in `tests/test_m3_evaluator.py` covering arithmetic, `let` bindings, lexical closures, recursive functions (e.g. factorial and fibonacci), `if/else`, and `EvalError` on division by zero and undefined variables.

milestones.title: MiniLang Constant-Folding Bytecode Compiler & Stack Virtual Machine
milestones.objective:
Create `minilang/bytecode.py` and `tests/test_m4_bytecode.py` (and export in `minilang/__init__.py` if helpful), building on `m1_lexer`, `m2_parser`, and `m3_evaluator`. Keep the milestone delta compact (under 450 lines).

Requirements for `minilang/bytecode.py`:
1. `OpCode(Enum)` (or string/Enum opcodes) and `@dataclass class Instruction(op: Any, arg: Any = None)`.
2. `@dataclass class BytecodeChunk(instructions: List[Instruction], constants: List[Any] = ...)`.
3. Constant-folding pass (`fold_constants(node)` called by `compile_expr(src_or_ast, fold: bool = True)`):
   - Folds constant `UnaryOp` and `BinaryOp` subtrees at compile time (e.g., `2 + 3 * 4` folds to `NumberLiteral(14)` and emits a single `LOAD_CONST` instruction instead of multiple arithmetic instructions).
   - Do NOT fold division by zero at compile time so `VirtualMachine.run()` raises `EvalError` at runtime matching `evaluate()`.
4. `compile_expr(src_or_ast: Union[str, Any], fold: bool = True) -> BytecodeChunk`:
   - Compiles `MiniLang` source or AST into stack-based bytecode instructions (`LOAD_CONST`, `LOAD_VAR`, `STORE_VAR`, `UNARY_NEG`, `BINARY_ADD`, `BINARY_SUB`, `BINARY_MUL`, `BINARY_DIV`, `CMP_EQ`, `CMP_NEQ`, `CMP_LT`, `CMP_GT`, `CMP_LE`, `CMP_GE`, `JUMP_IF_FALSE`, `JUMP`, `MAKE_FN`, `CALL_FN`, `RETURN`, `HALT`).
5. `class VirtualMachine`:
   - `run(self, chunk_or_src: Union[BytecodeChunk, str], env: Optional[Environment] = None) -> Any`: executes the compiled `BytecodeChunk` (compiling first if passed a `str`) on an explicit operand stack + call frames / lexical `Environment`, raising `EvalError` on division by zero or undefined variables, and matching `evaluate(src)` across arithmetic, variables, `if/else` conditionals, closures, and recursive functions.
6. Write unit tests in `tests/test_m4_bytecode.py` verifying:
   - Constant folding reduces instruction count on constant expressions (`compile_expr('2 + 3 * 4', fold=True)` has fewer instructions than `fold=False`),
   - `VirtualMachine().run(compile_expr(src)) == evaluate(src)` across arithmetic, variables, `if/else`, closures, and recursive functions,
   - `EvalError` is raised on division by zero and undefined variables.
